findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_vat, find_student_visas, list_datasets · Private data: estimate_employer_cost, compare_tax_rates, compare_pension_systems, find_retirement_visas, retire_on_budget, compare_business_entry, compare_egov · Public sink: compare_healthcare, compare_housing, compare_connectivity, compare_public_holidays, compare_inflation, remittance_cost, pension_abroad, compare_banking_access, compare_pension_systems, compare_effective_tax, compare_childcare_cost, compare_trade_customs, compare_tax_burden, find_student_visas, country_dossier · Destructive: compare_housing, calculate_runway.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_vat, find_student_visas, list_datasets · Private data: estimate_employer_cost, compare_tax_rates, compare_pension_systems, find_retirement_visas, retire_on_budget, compare_business_entry, compare_egov · Public sink: compare_healthcare, compare_housing, compare_connectivity, compare_public_holidays, compare_inflation, remittance_cost, pension_abroad, compare_banking_access, compare_pension_systems, compare_effective_tax, compare_childcare_cost, compare_trade_customs, compare_tax_burden, find_student_visas, country_dossier · Destructive: compare_housing, calculate_runway

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
